dataset_info.name: Surat Police Real-World Investigation Path Benchmark
dataset_info.description: Benchmark dataset mimicking real-world police station cases in Surat, Gujarat (Surat Cyber Crime PS, Adajan PS, Varachha PS, Athwa PS, Katargam PS, Umra PS, Salabatpura PS) covering Cyber Financial Crimes, Digital Arrest Extortion, Property Frauds, Electronic Evidence Admissibility, and Field SOPs.

test_cases.crime_sub_type: Part Time Job Telegram Scam & Mule Account Layering
test_cases.complaint_text: Respected Sir, Main Rajesh Patel, resident of Adajan, Surat. Mujhe Telegram par part-time YouTube video liking job ka offer mila tha. Shuruat mein ₹500 commission mila, phir task complete karne ke naam par ₹4.5 Lakhs transfer karvaye. Maine ₹2,50,000 SBI Account 39201948102 (IFS Code SBIN0004012) se beneficiary account ICICI 00192847192 (Name: Ramesh Shah) mein UPI transaction id 419201948102 se bheje. Baad mein Axis Bank 91802938102 mein ₹2,00,000 transfer karvaye. Ab Telegram admin group se remove kar diya aur paisa wapas nahi mil raha. Mobile number +91 9825102948 aur Telegram handle @task_admin_surat tha. Please help me freeze the amount.

stage_1_emergency_response: Report immediately on National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (1930) for golden-hour freeze
Issue emergency lien mark requisition to ICICI Bank (Acc: 00192847192) and Axis Bank (Acc: 91802938102)
Freeze Layer-1 and Layer-2 beneficiary accounts via CFCFRMS portal
stage_2_technical_requisition: Issue notice under BNSS Section 94 to ICICI & Axis Nodal Officers for Account Aggregator KYC & IP logs
Requisition Telegram User ID IP log & registration details for @task_admin_surat
Issue CDR & Tower Location requisition under BNSS Section 94 to Telecom Service Provider for +91 9825102948
stage_3_evidence_forensics: Preserve Telegram chat logs & UPI transaction receipts
Obtain Section 63 BSA Electronic Evidence Certificate with SHA-256 Hash Value for mobile device screenshots
Conduct Search & Seizure Panchnama under BNSS Section 105 with mandatory audio-video recording upon suspect arrest
stage_4_statutory_sections: Section 318(4) BNS (Cheating & Dishonestly Inducing Delivery of Property)
Section 66D IT Act (Cheating by Impersonation using Computer Resource)
CFCFRMS Debit Freeze SOP & Gujarat Police Manual Vol III SOP

test_cases.complaint_text: Respected Officer, Main Sunita Mehta, resident of Ghoddod Road, Surat. Mujhe WhatsApp Video Call (+91 9102948102) aaya tha. Sender ne police uniform mein CBI Officer Devendra Sharma ban kar kaha ki mere naam par Mumbai Airport se courier package intercept hua hai jisme 5 Passport, 10 Synthetic Drugs aur Illegal SIM cards hain. Unhone mujhe WhatsApp camera ke samne 6 ghante tak 'Digital Arrest' rakha aur arrest warrant dikhaya. Supreme Court verification Fee ke naam par ₹12,00,000 transfer karvaye. Maine HDFC Bank Acc 501002938102 se HDFC Bank Beneficiary Acc 502001928471 mein RTGS transaction se bheje. Kindly take immediate action to arrest the fraudster and recover money.

stage_1_emergency_response: Initiate emergency freeze on HDFC Beneficiary Account 502001928471 via 1930 Portal & HDFC Nodal Officer
Issue stop-payment alert across inter-bank clearing for RTGS transaction
stage_2_technical_requisition: Requisition WhatsApp IP call log, subscriber details, and device IMEI for +91 9102948102
Issue BNSS Section 94 notice to HDFC Bank for beneficiary KYC, ATM withdrawal CCTV footage, and linked mobile number
stage_3_evidence_forensics: Record victim statement under BNSS Section 183
Preserve WhatsApp video call screenshot & fake arrest warrant document
Extract Section 63 BSA Electronic Evidence Certificate for WhatsApp chat and digital media
stage_4_statutory_sections: Section 318(4) BNS (Cheating & Dishonestly Inducing Delivery of Property)
Section 66D IT Act (Cheating by Impersonation using Computer Resource)
Gujarat Police Manual Digital Arrest SOP

test_cases.crime_sub_type: Gold Loan Fraud & Fake Document Forgery
test_cases.complaint_text: To the PI, Adajan Police Station, Surat. Main Arvindbhai Shah, Branch Manager, Muthoot Finance Adajan Branch. Hamari branch mein accused Manilal Choksi (Res: Pal, Surat, Mob: +91 9898012345) ne 250 grams duplicate gold ornaments pledge karke ₹14,50,000 ka gold loan liya tha. Appraisal report aur Aadhar Card submit kiya tha. Annual audit mein Gold Ornaments fake (copper coated) nikle aur submit kiya gaya Aadhar Card fake/forged tha. Aadhar Number 918201948102. Request to register FIR and arrest accused.

stage_1_emergency_response: Seize duplicate gold ornaments and pledged loan agreement documents
stage_2_technical_requisition: Issue notice under BNSS Section 94 to UIDAI for verification of Aadhar Number 918201948102
Obtain branch CCTV footage of transaction and accused entry
stage_3_evidence_forensics: Conduct Spot Inspection & Seizure Panchnama under BNSS Section 105 with mandatory audio-video recording
Send duplicate gold ornaments to Directorate of Forensic Science (DFS) Gandhinagar for purity testing
Obtain Section 63 BSA Certificate for CCTV footage and digital loan records
stage_4_statutory_sections: Section 340 BNS (Using Forged Document as Genuine)
Gujarat Police Manual Vol II Chapter IV (Seizure & Panchnama SOP)

test_cases.crime_sub_type: Diamond Trading Cheating & Breach of Trust
test_cases.complaint_text: To Station House Officer, Varachha Police Station, Surat. Main Bhavesh Diamond LLP ka partner Ramesh Patel. Hamari firm ne accused Suresh Goti (Varachha, Surat, Mob: +91 9426019284) ko 45 Carats rough diamonds worth ₹35,00,000 jangad (consignment slip) par cutting & polishing ke liye diye the. Receipt slip no 4910 sign kiya tha. 15 days hone par accused ne mobile switch off kar diya aur dukan band karke abscond ho gaya. Rough diamonds market mein illegal sale karne ki jankari mili hai. Request FIR and recovery.

stage_1_emergency_response: Register FIR under BNS Section 316(2) (Criminal Breach of Trust) & 318(4) (Cheating)
Alert Surat Diamond Association & local angadia networks regarding stolen rough diamonds
stage_2_technical_requisition: Obtain CDR & Live Location dump under BNSS Section 94 for +91 9426019284
Issue notice to local diamond markets in Mini Bazar Varachha & Mahidharpura
stage_3_evidence_forensics: Seize original jangad receipt slip no 4910 and ledger entries
Execute Panchnama under BNSS Section 105 for shop inspection with video recording
Execute arrest & recovery under Gujarat Police Manual Vol III guidelines
stage_4_statutory_sections: Gujarat Police Manual Chapter V (Property Recovery SOP)
